# Flow Board

> Flow Board is a simple Kanban board that runs entirely in the browser. Cards are stored in the browser's localStorage; there is no account, server or tracking.

## What it does
- Four columns: Backlog, In Progress, In Review, Done
- Cards have a title, assignee, priority (High, Medium, Low) and due date
- Move cards by drag and drop, by arrow buttons, or with the keyboard (N = new card, Enter = edit)
- Search by title or assignee, filter by priority
- Overdue and due-soon highlighting
- Undo for deleted cards (10 seconds)
- Export and import the board as JSON
- Changes sync across open tabs
- Built to WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard operable, screen-reader labelled, light and dark themes
